Question: What is the average review score for orders that contain more than one item?
text:
```sql
SELECT AVG(orr.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_reviews AS orr
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS multi_item_orders
ON orr.order_id = multi_item_orders.order_id;
```
This calculates the average review score for all orders that have more than one item.
reasoning:
We need average review score for orders that contain more than one item. Need to join order_reviews with order_items to count items per order, filter count >1, then average review_score.

Schema: order_items(order_id,...). order_reviews(review_id, order_id, review_score,...). So query:

SELECT AVG(orr.review_score) FROM order_reviews orr JOIN (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) oi ON orr.order_id = oi.order_id;

Return SQL and explanation.
